target.title: fix(file-transfer): suppress stdout/stderr stream errors in tar listing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where stdout/stderr pipe errors from tar listing could surface as unhandled Node stream errors during file-transfer node policy checks.

## Why This Change Was Made

`node-invoke-policy.ts` spawns `tar -tzf` with pipe stdio to list archive entries. The code already handles `child.stdin.on("error", ...)` for stdin failures, but stdout and stderr lack error listeners. If the tar process terminates abnormally, Node emits `error` events on the unguarded streams.

The fix adds the standard no-op error listener pattern on both stdout and stderr.

## User Impact

File-transfer node-invoke policy checks no longer risk unhandled stream errors during edge-case tar failures.

## Evidence

- The existing `child.on("error", ...)` process-level handler covers spawn failures; the new stream-level handlers cover independent pipe failures.
- The `child.stdin.on("error", ...)` guard (line 429) already handles stdin EPIPE — the new handlers complete coverage for all three stdio streams.
